mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a folklore based on the exploits of Ananse (spider)."
The play is a folklore based on the exploits of Ananse (spider).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for any situation or action which creates a sense of an abnormality or the unexpected."
The dramatic is used for any situation or action which creates a sense of an abnormality or the unexpected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an imaginative art which expresses thoughts and feelings of the artist on events around him."
Literature is an imaginative art which expresses thoughts and feelings of the artist on events around him.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described in the play as a fashionable woman."
Christie Miss Christina Yamoah is described in the play as a fashionable woman.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the choice or selection of the words which forms the dialogue through which the playwright communicates his ideas to his audience."
Diction is the choice or selection of the words which forms the dialogue through which the playwright communicates his ideas to his audience.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series of incidents whose development does not necessarily depend on each other which means that the incidents may or may not be related or connected."
A story is a series of incidents whose development does not necessarily depend on each other which means that the incidents may or may not be related or connected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to emphasize the fact that until the head-drink is placed by a suitor for his bride-to-be, he has no claim over her."
The Akwani and Akosua episode is used to emphasize the fact that until the head-drink is placed by a suitor for his bride-to-be, he has no claim over her.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called a play and the writer is called a playwright."
The text is called a play and the writer is called a playwright.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a semi-literate reformist and a teacher of Geography who would like to introduce some radical and revolutionary reforms into the political and social lives of Ilujinle."
Lakunle is a semi-literate reformist and a teacher of Geography who would like to introduce some radical and revolutionary reforms into the political and social lives of Ilujinle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important instrument in comedy because nothing reforms majority of men like the portrayal of their faults."
Satire is an important instrument in comedy because nothing reforms majority of men like the portrayal of their faults.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main idea in a play that permeates the entire play."
Theme is the main idea in a play that permeates the entire play.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the arrangement of a story in such a way that there will be a sequential, logical and chronological order."
Plot in simple terms is the arrangement of a story in such a way that there will be a sequential, logical and chronological order.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good planner and a strategist."
Sadiku is a good planner and a strategist.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a decent but uneducated village girl who wants to maintain her dignity."
Sidi is a decent but uneducated village girl who wants to maintain her dignity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a moralist who condemns his mother's "quick but unthoughtful" second marriage to the king."
Hamlet is a moralist who condemns his mother's "quick but unthoughtful" second marriage to the king.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means for revealing characters, it is used to make significant commentaries on events of the play."
Apart from serving as a means for revealing characters, it is used to make significant commentaries on events of the play.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the themes of betrayal and revenge."
Enclosed in this main theme are the themes of betrayal and revenge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most esteemed of all the dramatic genres."
Tragedy is the most esteemed of all the dramatic genres.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of series of complications."
The middle is made up of series of complications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a play that mixes both comic and tragic elements in equal proportion of each."
Tragi-comedy is a play that mixes both comic and tragic elements in equal proportion of each.
fib: ______ is a deliberate presentation of events/experiences drawn from real life but not the same with real life.
Comedy
Comedy is a deliberate presentation of events/experiences drawn from real life but not the same with real life.
______ is the structure of the actions which is ordered and presented in order to achieve particular emotional and artistic effects in a play.
Plot
Plot is the structure of the actions which is ordered and presented in order to achieve particular emotional and artistic effects in a play.
______ is one of Shakespeare's best constructed plays.
Suspense Hamlet
Suspense Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's best constructed plays.
______ is an invitation for a closer relationship and an embrace.
song
The song is an invitation for a closer relationship and an embrace.
______ is a new element which changes the direction of the action.
complication
A complication is a new element which changes the direction of the action.
______ are used to present the story.
Characters
Characters are used to present the story.
______ is an adaptation, recreation and reflection of reality on stage.
Drama
Drama is an adaptation, recreation and reflection of reality on stage.
______ are used to show the priorities of the society in which emphasis is placed on wealth.
Labourers and the Postman
The Labourers and the Postman are used to show the priorities of the society in which emphasis is placed on wealth.
______ is a very brief remark and in most cases it is indicated in the stage direction.
aside
An aside is a very brief remark and in most cases it is indicated in the stage direction.
______ is a verbal entertainment in Ijawland.
riddle
The riddle is a verbal entertainment in Ijawland.
______ are the persons in a dramatic work.
Characterization Characters
Characterization Characters are the persons in a dramatic work.
______ is the evaluation of a written play.
Textual analysis in drama
Textual Analysis Textual analysis in drama is the evaluation of a written play.
______ is described as a crafty rouge and a fox.
Baroka
Baroka is described as a crafty rouge and a fox.
______ is a discussion between two or more people.
Dialogue
Dialogue is a discussion between two or more people.
______ is a short but complete play incorporated into the main play.
play-within-play
Play-Within-the-Play The play-within-play is a short but complete play incorporated into the main play.
______ means that there must be a good reason for any action that is taken by every character in the play.
Motivation in characterization
Motivation in characterization means that there must be a good reason for any action that is taken by every character in the play.
______ is a Swiss mercenary who fought on the side of the Serbs during the Serbian- Bulgarian war.
Bluntschili Bluntschli
Bluntschili Bluntschli is a Swiss mercenary who fought on the side of the Serbs during the Serbian- Bulgarian war.
______ are the unities of time place and action.
three unities
The three unities are the unities of time place and action.
______ is an important aspect of dramatic technique.
Characterization
Characterization is an important aspect of dramatic technique.
